This file IS the source document, so `transcribed_from` names its own path: it is the artefact under review, not a transcription of one. The volume was supplied as one combined PDF and cut into parts at its own headings, so this file is a page-range slice of a single extraction and its page ids (PDF pages None–None, no printed page numbers on these pages) are the combined document's own, not renumbered from 0. Front matter (cover and title page, contents, list of sections, foreword, statement of policy, personnel, correspondence, summary of changes, cross-referencing) and back matter (back cover) were deleted from the drop before supply and are NOT filed; the drop's `content.json`, `index.json`, `meta.json` and `README.md` are retained beside the kind folders, unfiled, for the same reason. The edition — 2025 Edition (ASME BPVC.II.B-2025), issued 2025-07-01 — is stated on the title page, which this drop no longer carries as a filed cut: it survives only inside the retained `content.json`, so no filed cut of this standard prints its own edition. This cut carries no figure.

children.html: SPECIFICATION FOR COPPER-SILICON ALLOY PLATE, SHEET, STRIP, AND ROLLED BAR FOR GENERAL PURPOSES AND PRESSURE VESSELS
(Identical with ASTM Specification B96/B96M-20 except yield strength is required.)
Specification for Copper-Silicon Alloy Plate, Sheet, Strip, and Rolled Bar for General Purposes and Pressure Vessels

1.1 This specification establishes the requirements for copper-silicon alloy plate, sheet, strip, and rolled bar for drawing, forming, stamping, bending, and general engineering applications, and for pressure vessel applications. The alloys involved are copper alloys UNS Nos. C65100, C65400, and C65500.
1.2 When product is ordered for ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code applications, consult the Code for applicable alloys.

1.3 Units—The values stated in either inch-pound units or SI units are to be regarded separately as standard. Within the text, SI units are shown in brackets. The values stated in each system are not necessarily exact equivalents; therefore, to ensure conformance with the standard, each system shall be used independently of the other, and values from the two systems shall not be combined.

1.4 This international standard was developed in accordance with internationally recognized principles on standardization established in the Decision on Principles for the Development of International Standards, Guides and Recommendations issued by the World Trade Organization Technical Barriers to Trade (TBT) Committee.

6.1 The material shall conform to the chemical composition requirements in Table 3 for the copper [alloy] UNS No. designation specified in the ordering information.
6.2 These composition limits do not preclude the presence of other elements. By agreement between the manufacturer and purchaser, limits may be established and analysis required for unnamed elements.

6.3 For alloys in which copper is listed as "remainder," copper is the difference between the sum of results of all elements determined and 100 %. When all elements in Table 3 are determined, the sum of results shall be 99.5 % min.
7.1 The standard tempers for products described in this specification are in Tables 1 and 2 and Tables 4 and 5.
7.1.1 Hot rolled temper M20. 7.1.2 Hot rolled and rerolled temper M25. 7.1.3 Cold rolled tempers H01 to H14. 7.1.4 Annealed tempers O50 or O61.
8.1 The approximate grain size values for annealed tempers given in Tables 1 and 2 and Tables 4 and 5 are for general information and shall not be used as a basis for product rejection.
9.1.1 Product furnished under this specification shall conform to the tensile requirements prescribed in Table 1, Table 2, Table 4, or Table 5, when tested in accordance with Test Methods E8/E8M.
9.1.2 DELETED 9.1.3 The tension test specimens shall be taken so the longitudinal axis of the specimens is parallel to the direction of rolling.

9.2.1 Product furnished under this specification shall conform to the yield strength requirements prescribed in Tables 1 and 2 when tested in accordance with Test Methods E8/E8M. The purchaser must specify at the time of ordering which yield strength method shall be used.
9.3.1 Product furnished under this specification shall be capable of conforming to the elongation requirements prescribed in Tables 1 and 2 when tested in accordance with Test Methods E8/E8M.

11.2 Finish—The material is supplied regularly in the following finishes:
11.2.1 Black—After hot rolling retains all of the oxides.
11.2.2 Plain Pickled—Sulfuric acid pickle only, brick red oxide; has cuprous and silicon oxides still adherent.
11.2.3 Specially Cleaned—Commercially free of all oxides; has the golden color of the alloy.
11.2.4 Sand Blasted—Commercially free of all oxides; has a dull gray color.
